task: Validate the SDK 5.1.0 release metadata in PR #997 without publishing or enabling hosted/Bitcoin features.

criteria.description: SDK 5.1.0, vh 0.3.0, auth 4.0.2 and landing 0.4.0 match workspace lock versions and have matching changelog headings.

Compared with the PR base, changes outside REV evidence are limited to package versions, changelogs, consumed changesets and workspace lock metadata; the dependency resolution graph and runtime code are unchanged.
Release workflow contract tests pass, preserving explicit release decisions, OIDC authentication and build/import gates. This does not prove npm trust configuration or public-host/Bitcoin acceptance.
